title: Arrive
summary: Three minutes to land in your body and in the room.

segments.text: Welcome. For the next few minutes, there's nothing to get right.
Let yourself settle into whatever position feels okay today. Sitting, lying down, or leaning against something. All of it works.
If it feels comfortable, let your eyes close. Or let your gaze rest softly on one spot in front of you.
Notice where your body meets the surface under you. The weight of your legs. Your back. Your hands.
Now bring your attention to your breath, without changing it. Just notice it coming in, and going out.
If your mind is busy, that's fine. Notice that it's busy, and come back to the next breath.
Let the next breath out be a little slower than the one before.
And one more, slow and unhurried.
You've arrived. Whatever comes next in your day, you can come back to this breath at any time.
When you're ready, open your eyes, and take a moment before you move on.
